acceptanceCriteria: Retain and minimize interruption/resume reproduction against an official compatible Codex runtime, with no source or account state loss.
Determine whether durable history projection actually loses entries or only logs stale retry warnings, and classify confirmed versus suspected failure.
Document an upstream fix or supported safe workaround and verify resumed bounded workers still preserve source and final handback evidence.
body: Observed concrete tooling friction with Codex CLI0.153.2 during CEM native repair: root safely interrupted owned codex exec session01a0faa8-8b8a-7810-9868-ca1392251faa with its supervisor SIGTERM after focused test process had finished, preserving source/scratch. codex exec resume same ID then repeatedly logs codex_thread_store::local::live_writer failed to project durable rollout: expected ordinal333, got332. Resumed worker executes approved source operations, but UI/durable-history completeness has not been verified; no confirmed corruption claim. Raw retained log /private/tmp/cem10-codex-control/native-empty-tree-proof-repair.log and owned interruption evidence native-empty-tree-repair-state/root-steering-interruption.json. Expected: interruption/resume preserves coherent durable history or clearly reports recoverable limitation without implicit loss. Actual: repeated projection warnings. Do not erase thread stores or unrelated histories to repair it.
title: Investigate Codex CLI resumed worker durable history projection warnings
